questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{对离散型随机变量 }(X,Y)\text{ 若 }p_{ij}=p_i\cdot p_j\text{，则 }X\text{ 与 }Y\text{ 相互独立。}\\&\text{两个离散型选项的边缘分布律分别为}\\&\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}\hline X & 1/2 & 1 & 2 \\\hline p_i & 1/4 & 1/4 & 1/2 \\\hline\end{array}\quad\text{与}\quad\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}\hline Y & -1 & 0 & 1 \\\hline p_j & 2/5 & 1/5 & 2/5 \\\hline\end{array}\\&\text{与}\quad \begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}\hline X & 1 & 2 & 3 \\\hline p_i & 0.1 & 0.2 & 0.7 \\\hline\end{array}\quad\text{，}\quad\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}\hline Y & 1 & 2 & 3 \\\hline p_j & 0.1 & 0.3 & 0.6 \\\hline\end{array}\\&\text{均满足 }p_i\cdot p_j=p_{ij}\text{，故 }X\text{ 与 }Y\text{ 相互独立。}\\&\text{对于连续型随机变量 }(X,Y)\text{，若 }f(x,y)=f_X(x)f_Y(y)\text{，则 }X\text{ 与 }Y\text{ 相互独立。}\\&f_X(x)=\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}f(x,y)\,dy=\int_0^1(x+y)\,dy=x+\frac{1}{2},\quad (0\leq x\leq 1);\\&f_Y(y)=\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}f(x,y)\,dx=\int_0^1(x+y)\,dx=y+\frac{1}{2},\quad (0\leq y\leq 1),\\&f_X(x)f_Y(y)=\left(x+\frac{1}{2}\right)\left(y+\frac{1}{2}\right)\neq f(x,y)=x+y\quad (0\leq x\leq 1,\ 0\leq y\leq 1),\\&\text{所以 }X\text{ 与 }Y\text{ 不相互独立。}\\&\text{同理可验证，概率密度为 }f(x,y)=\begin{cases}\frac{1}{5},&1\leq x\leq 2,\ 0\leq y\leq 5\\0,&\text{其他}\end{cases}\text{ 的 }X\text{ 与 }Y\text{ 相互独立。}\end{aligned}
